create.name: Integral Yoga Institute Montreal
create.bio:
The Integral Yoga Institute Montreal (Institut de Yoga Intégral) is a not-for-profit studio that has taught the Integral Yoga of Swami Satchidananda in the city since 1972. The method combines gentle postures, breathing practices, the tradition's long guided deep relaxation and meditation, taught so that people of any age, build or ability can take part, in an interfaith spirit summed up in the line that truth is one and paths are many. Susheela Susan Bouthillier is named as its contact in Integral Yoga's international directory.

The institute occupies a calm upstairs practice room with a yantra painting, a lounge and a small lending library on Avenue du Parc, in the Mile End and Plateau area of Montreal. Its main public class is a bilingual Friday-evening Integral Flow session that moves through about an hour of breath-led postures before deep relaxation, pranayama and meditation, offered by donation so that cost is no obstacle. On Sunday afternoons an informal circle of spiritual friends meets there for meditation, kirtan, readings and sharing, and teachers give private classes by arrangement. Guest teachers occasionally run short hatha series in the room.

courses.title: Integral Flow (Friday community class)
courses.description: A bilingual Friday-evening class for all levels: about an hour of gentle, breath-led sequences, then deep relaxation, breathing practice and guided meditation. The autumn session began on 11 September 2026 and runs weekly apart from listed holiday dates.
courses.price: By donation / Pay what you can ($15 suggested)

courses.title: Meditation and Kirtan (Sunday gathering)
courses.description: An informal Sunday-afternoon circle that meets at the institute for meditation, devotional chanting, readings and sharing, drawing on Integral Yoga and other contemplative traditions. Newcomers write to the group first for details.

courses.title: Private Yoga Classes
courses.description: One-to-one sessions shaped around the student after a short conversation, combining postures, breathing, meditation and guided deep relaxation. Suited to beginners or anyone who cannot attend the group class.

flags: Lead from the Integral Yoga Teachers Association's centre directory (iyta.org/directory/centers/): 'Integral Yoga Institute – Montreal', Susheela Susan Bouthillier, integralyoga-montreal.org. Facts from the institute's own site (robots.txt allows us).

Thin-ish: one weekly public class, a peer-run Sunday meditation group, private classes and one embedded video; no teacher training or workshops currently scheduled. Kept because the school has a long history and solid contact, photo and base; owner may judge it too thin.

Health rule: the site frames Integral Yoga as 'healing and stress relief' and the Friday class as 'therapeutic'; private classes are offered for 'pain or injury'. The bio and items describe only the practice.
Email is shown on the contact page as 'info [at] integralyoga-montreal.org' but behind a clickable mailto link (not encoded), so treated as published.
The Sunday Meditation and Kirtan group is run by a small informal group with a personal contact address; it draws on Integral Yoga, Buddhism, shamanism and psychology.
Video is from the official Integral Yoga channel, embedded on the institute's Media page; not the institute's own channel.
Lineage note: Swami Satchidananda (died 2002) faced sexual-misconduct allegations in the 1990s; from general knowledge, no source opened. Nothing found about current leadership.
Base is Montreal, a large city but outside the big US coastal cities; few Spiritpedia listings in Quebec.
Possible future listings: none named beyond the directory contact (Susheela Susan Bouthillier).
No Spiritpedia teachers named on the site; teachers file has no links.
